piece.headline: LEVEL PEGGING: PARTH AND SUKRUT CAN'T BE SPLIT
piece.standfirst: 2 managers share top spot on 238, Aryan's Triple Captain lights up the week, and Sukrut leaves a small fortune on the bench.
piece.big_picture: Sukrut and Parth are level at the top on 238, both having played the Free Hit. Nothing separates them. Sukrut left 26 points on the bench, so he is the one who will be wincing. Nihar sits third.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sukrut picked the wrong 11 and left 26 points on the bench. On a Free Hit, in a title race, that is the costliest selection of the week. He still tied for top. Lucky escape.
piece.one_to_watch: Parth and Sukrut are level at the top with nothing between them. If either one gets the armband right next week, they could open the first real gap. Both have spent the Free Hit.

winners.name: Aryan
winners.verdict: Triple Captain on Haaland brought 27 points from the armband alone. Nerve, and it paid. The Wirtz and Mendy swap added 7 more.

winners.name: Aryamann
winners.verdict: Martinez and Gakpo came in and the swap gained 11 points. That is smart work, and a 3-place climb is the reward.

winners.name: Nihar
winners.verdict: Nihar was the only manager to captain Isak, and the armband returned 26. Going against 22 Haaland captains paid off with third place.

losers.name: Shantanu
losers.verdict: Sole captain of Cherki, who scored 6. Backing a lone hunch is brave, but this one cost the week's lowest score.

losers.name: Prerana
losers.verdict: Prerana brought in Cherki for a 5-point hit, then left 17 points on the bench. That one was selection, not luck.

ratings.l: Triple Captain used, and the week's best score followed. Perfectly timed chip.
